description: Inlined deliberately. This repo previously extended github>staticrevolution-com/renovate-config, which is PRIVATE while this repo is PUBLIC — the hosted Renovate app will not read a private preset for a public consumer, so it halted and opened no PRs at all between 2026-08-21 and 2026-09-25. The shared preset is also ~90% Docker-datasource rules, and this repo has no compose files. See issue #14.

packageRules.description: devDependency patch/minor updates. ⚠ automerge is OFF deliberately: this fleet's convention is that merges to a default branch route to a human, and an agent-opened PR merging itself would bypass the only human checkpoint. Kept as a labelled, low-friction PR instead.
Runtime dependencies are never auto-merged. ws is the WebSocket transport under every TrueNAS call and the MCP SDK defines the tool plane; both get a human.
Group GitHub Actions bumps into one PR. They are pinned to digests, so individually they are noise.
